as_told.title: Fire in the Sky: Hollywood replaced Travis Walton's real abduction

plain: In 1975, in Arizona, a young forestry worker named Travis Walton says he was taken aboard a UFO, and his story was later made into a Hollywood film called Fire in the Sky. A guest on a podcast, Chris Ramsay, says the film played the events very differently from Walton's own account. In the film, he says, the beings doing a procedure on Walton ignored his screams. A second person, Bryce, passes on what he heard from Tracy Tormé, who was involved with the film. According to Bryce, the filmmakers told Tormé that Walton's real story was not good enough and that they needed a better abduction. Both tellers are relaying others, and together they suggest the frightening film version was Hollywood's invention, not what Walton describes.
